svg.title: UIABO overall product hierarchy — functionality WBS
svg.desc: Six modules with working prototype functions in green and planned functions in amber. This is a functional decomposition, not a process flow or schedule.
svg.text: AI misinformation detection for short-form content
WORKING — implemented in the text prototype
PLANNED — product scope; not yet implemented
Deepfake applies to static images and remains required. Audio and video are excluded. Premium allowance is active; paid billing is not.
Working indicates available functionality, not validated detection accuracy. Source: UIABO PTD §§7.1–7.5 and URS §2.2.
